papers.title: Single-Particle Nanoimpact Electrochemistry Reveals Zn2+ Storage Dynamics in CuMn Prussian Blue Analogues

papers.digest: This work pioneers single-particle nanoimpact electrochemistry to directly observe Zn2+ insertion/extraction dynamics in CuMn Prussian blue analogues, linking stochastic particle collisions to bulk battery performance. It reveals particle-level charge-storage mechanisms, supported by in situ Raman spectroscopy, and demonstrates the technique's utility for advancing aqueous zinc-ion battery research.

papers.digest: This work first links plating-induced stress heterogeneity to Zn dendrite initiation via chemical-potential gradients. A stress-relieving additive enables (100)-textured Zn, homogenizing compressive stress and suppressing dendrites, yielding 3500 h symmetric-cell cycling and over 10,000 cycles in Zn||I2 cells. It offers a stress-regulation strategy for dendrite-free metal anodes.

papers.title: The ocean within planetary boundaries: complexity, tipping risks and pathways to a safe operating space

papers.title: Spatially Selective Substitution Enabled [001]‐Oriented Li 1.2 Ni 0.2 Mn 0.6 O 2 Cathodes With Coupled Regulation of Li + Transport and Oxygen Stability
papers.fa_summary: این مقاله با دوپینگ انتخابی Mo6+ و Sr2+، کاتدهای غنی از لیتیوم Li1.2Ni0.2Mn0.6O2 با جهت‌گیری [001] و بهبود همزمان انتقال Li+ و پایداری اکسیژن را ارائه می‌دهد.
papers.digest: This work pioneers selective Mo6+/Sr2+ doping to tune facet energetics, enabling [001]-oriented quasi-single-crystal Li-rich cathodes. papers.title: Design and model choices shape inference of age-varying genetic effects on complex traits

papers.title: Mass‐Charge Regulatory Microdomains Enable Coupled Structural and Interfacial Stabilization of Durable 3D Lithium Metal Anodes

It offers a structure-level strategy beyond compositional or surface tuning, enabling high-rate, long-life sodium-ion batteries.

The dual-functional design enables 10,000 h Zn cycling and 4,000-cycle Zn–S batteries, offering a holistic pathway for reversible aqueous zinc–sulfur batteries.

papers.digest: Vacancy-mediated sulfur exchange is identified as a new mechanism accelerating sulfur redox in Li–S batteries.
